entities.title: Online match messages
entities.summary: What a browser sends other players through the games hub's relay.
consumers: Shatterbelt and Hivestorm, which carry the same src/online.ts
The games hub's relay, which passes messages on in order
guarantees: start: { slots, seed, delay }, sent by the host
in: { f, b }, the sender's controls from step f on
sum: { f, h }, a fingerprint of step f
rtt: { ms }, the sender's round trip, when it changes by 5 ms or more
entities.compatibility: The three games' copies change together, with test/online.test.ts.

entities.title: The session name
entities.summary: sessionStorage games.name: the table name, shared by every game on icelander.net.
guarantees: Holds a name already cleaned by cleanName.
